title: JuliaRobotics: Making robots walk with Julia | Robin Deits
summary: Robin Deits presents the JuliaRobotics organization and shows how Julia is used to visualize, simulate and control a humanoid robot. The talk touches on real-time performance and composability across packages.
why: Julia fans point to it as a concrete example of Julia working for soft real-time robotics, especially when avoiding heap allocation.

quote.text: There's a nice talk here [1] about using julia in soft-real-time for robotics.
